entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
... Applicants
 V/s.
 The State of Maharashtra & Anr. ...

Respondents
 Mr. Samay Pawar i/by Mr. Nitesh J. Mohite for the
 applicants.
Mr. P.H. Gaikwad, App for respondent No.1/State.
Mr. Rushikesh Kale for respondent No.2.

Coram : Amit Borkar, J.
 Dated : August 19, 2023
 P.C.:

1. Apprehending arrest in connection with C.R. No.21 of 2023 registered with Vimantal Police Station, Pune for offences punishable under Sections 406, 420 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, the applicant is seeking relief of pre- arrest bail under Section 438 of the Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
2. According to prosecution, the applicants are alleged to be promoters/builders of Row House Scheme under Sapphire Villa Project at Lohgaon.

Informant has booked Row House No.13 in Saphire Villa Project of applicants, on payment of total Rs.15 lakh by cheques/in cash out of sale consideration of Rs.26 lakh in the 43-aba669-2023.doc month of February 2022.
Applicants did not give the possession of said row house to him.
Applicants have committed criminal breach of trust and cheated him.

Accordingly, first information report came to be lodged and notice under Section Sharad Vasudev Khandve And Ors vs State Of Maharashtra on 19 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101326875/
1 41-A of the Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 has been issued against the applicants.

entities.text: Section Sharad Vasudev Khandve And Ors vs State Of Maharashtra
entities.label: PROVISION

sentences.text: 3. During pendency of the present anticipatory bail application, the applicants and the informant have resolved their disputes.
Consent terms are filed before this Court on 3 May 2023.
The anticipatory bail application was adjourned to enable parties to comply with the consent terms.
Both the parties jointly state that consent terms are complied with.

c) The applicants shall cooperate with the investigation and make himself available for interrogation whenever 43-aba669-2023.doc required;
5.
The anticipatory bail application stands disposed of in above terms.
No costs.

(AMIT BORKAR, J.)
